# agents v0.6.0 — layout manifests, store roots, and migration

This release adds `agents.layout/v2`: a manifest at `.agents/layout.json` that
makes the four documentation roles — `design`, `plans`, `journal`, `qna` —
resolvable to any repository-relative path. A repository with no manifest keeps
the v1 `docs/` layout and its behavior is unchanged.

## Read this before you upgrade anything

**Deploy before flip.** A v0.5.1 binary cannot see a manifest. Measured on a
disposable fixture on 2026-09-18, an older binary on a v2 repository recreates
`docs/{design,plans,journal,qna}/README.md` and overwrites a v2-aware
migration skill with its own embedded text. There is no technical guard
possible from inside the manifest, so this ordering is the guard:

1. Every machine that can run `agents init`, `agents update --all --apply`, or
   `agents save` against the fleet must resolve **v0.6.0** on `PATH` before any
   repository is migrated. Verify with `agents version` **and** `agents doctor`'s
   `binary` check, which proves the resolved `agents` is the running executable.
2. Only then run a repository migration.

A repository below its manifest's `min_mut_ver_floor` still reads and displays,
and refuses every mutation.

## The migration path

```bash
agents layout show --json                 # what this repository resolves to
agents layout migrate --dry-run           # the plan; writes nothing
agents layout migrate --apply --backup-tag pre-layout-v2-YYYYMMDD
agents layout migrate --resume --apply    # after a crash or an interruption
agents layout migrate --abort --apply     # only while nothing can have moved
```

- Dry run is the default, and `--dry-run` is an accepted synonym.
- `--backup-tag` is required for any `--apply` that can move something; the tool
  creates the annotated tag at `HEAD` before its first write.
- `--resume` continues the journal the first run froze; it never re-plans and
  never re-tags.
- `--abort --apply` is available only while `phase` is `planned`, every move is
  still `pending`, and the manifest is one this migration created. Every later
  phase refuses and names `--resume --apply`.
- No step copies a file: `git mv` is the only mechanism, so history and blob
  identity are preserved.
- The archive recorded in the manifest is never moved, rewritten, or walked.

## Measured fleet baseline

Measured read-only on 2026-09-18 with v0.5.1, and re-measured on 2026-09-19 with
v0.6.0: **this release adds no new v1 advisory.**

| Repository | State |
|---|---|
| `dotfiles`, `paperbubble`, `cowork`, `lewm-mlx` | current — v1, router current, both skills current, 4/4 stores |
| `autogo-mlx` | non-current — router missing, recording skill missing, 1/4 stores, 2 misplaced docs |
| `desktop_pet` | non-current — router diverged, domain missing, recording skill missing, 0/4 stores |

The last two were already non-current for pre-existing 2026-08-29 two-tier
reasons that this release neither creates nor clears, so `agents drift --all`
already exited 1 before it. A new `known_legacy` or `diverged` on any of the
first four is a regression in the v1 asset selection, not an expected advisory.

## Vocabulary changes

Two state machines now share one vocabulary. `drift.skills` values changed from
`ok`/`clean_legacy`/`customized` to `current`/`known_legacy`/`diverged`, and the
router states from `clean_current`/`clean_legacy`/`drifted` to
`current`/`known_legacy`/`diverged`. No exit code changed. `doctor`'s
`docs:qna` check is now `layout:qna`, resolved through the `qna` role.

`DriftReport.docs_stores` is deprecated and will be removed no earlier than
v0.8.0; the new `stores` field is the resolved role→path map.

## What did not change

- A repository with no `.agents/layout.json` is v1 and behaves exactly as
  before, including `agents init --local` and the `docs/` stores.
- `agents save` is unchanged. It is not to be used mid-migration: the manifest
  and the moved stores must land in one commit.
- `docs/archive/` stays where it is. Its immutability is content-blind: the
  archive is a place, not a topic, so nothing under it is ever moved, rewritten,
  or reclassified, whatever it holds.
